summary:
Implemented the rich_measure/VerticalCenter feature by editing files only; nothing was run or committed, so tests are unverified.

Changes:
- rich/tree.py: added Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative DFS with explicit stack, 4 cells of indent per level, min = widest unbreakable label + indent, max = widest label + indent). Added the Measurement import.
- rich/align.py: added Align.__repr__; Align rendering now constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum (or the smaller of that and an explicit width); added VerticalCenter with render (newline-segment padding based on console.size.height), measurement delegation, and repr. Not registered in rich/__init__.py.
- rich/console.py: print's render options now use justify="default"; the justify argument still goes into _collect_renderables.
- CHANGELOG.md: 9.8.0 heading marked Unreleased, with an Added subsection for Tree measurement and VerticalCenter; existing entry kept.
- tests/test_align.py: imported VerticalCenter; added repr tests for Align, a VerticalCenter rendering test on a height-6 console (expects "\n\nfoo\n\n\n"), a VerticalCenter repr test, and a measurement test (3, 3).
- tests/test_tree.py: imported Measurement; added a measurement test for the acceptance tree (11, 19).

Not done: no tests were run, and nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only.
